theorem.formula: mu_ijk = m_ijk(F)-t_ijk(F) mod gcd(pairwise linking numbers)
theorem.published_pages: 559-562, definitions in section 2 and theorem on page 561
theorem.scope: This checker admits only pairwise-zero links, for which the residue is an integer. Unit mu does not classify ambient isotopy. The theorem is imported, not reproved or formalized.
theorem.side_conditions: Three oriented embedded Seifert surfaces with pairwise disjoint link boundaries in general position; the checked PL rectangles have all intersections away from polygon corners and are locally smoothable there
theorem.title: A geometric interpretation of Milnor's triple linking numbers
